366:t_012:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Take us out, $$バルビエル$$.」

366:t_013:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is going with $$バルビエル$$...」

366:t_013:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「What the hell is going on, $n!?」

366:t_013:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Pull yourself together, $n! $$ギルター$$ is coming!」

366:t_014:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You're pathetic, $$いがみ合う双子$$! I'll put you out of your misery!」

366:t_014:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「It's no use! From here, we can't...!」

366:t_016:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Th-That's impossible!! My once-in-a-lifetime chance...!」

366:t_016:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Like I give a damn about your problems. Get lost already, you poisonous mushroom.」

366:t_016:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Grrr!! Y-You'll pay for this!!」

366:t_018:0.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $n. I was held up looking for $$オルソン$$'s $$オーガスⅡ$$.」

366:t_018:1.en:
$$桂$$
「If I'd gotten here sooner, Miss $$スズネ$$ would have...」

366:t_018:2.en:
$n
「...It isn't your fault, $$桂$$... If only I'd noticed something was wrong with Miss $$スズネ$$...」

366:t_018:4.en:
$$桂$$
「...Let's go. First, we'll finish off the remaining enemies.」

366:t_019:0.en:
$$オルソン$$
「$$桂$$... I'll devote myself to supporting you. I'm counting on you to take the offensive.」

366:t_019:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「It's no use... We've already lost him.」

366:t_019:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, mop up the enemy.」

366:t_019:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do this. Right now, we need to focus on what's in front of us.」

366:t_020:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, $$オルソン$$. I'm afraid we're in no position to celebrate your safe return.」

366:t_021:1.en:
$$カリス$$
「It's been a while, $$ガロード$$.」

366:t_021:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$カリス$$! What are you doing here!?」

366:t_021:3.en:
$$カリス$$
「I'm fighting as a member of this area's resistance too.」

366:t_021:4.en:
$$カリス$$
「Right now, we're attacking that base in coordination with your movements.」

366:t_021:5.en:
$$カリス$$
「This is perfect. Let me support you.」

366:t_022:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you sure I can have this...?」

366:t_022:1.en:
$$カリス$$
「You can probably put this part to better use. I'm counting on you, $$ガロード$$.」

366:t_022:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks, $$カリス$$! But getting to see you again is the best resupply I could ask for!」

366:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(This is my chance...! If I dispose of $c here, I can restore my reputation...!)

366:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Above all, if I fail again, Lord $$バルビエル$$ will...!)

366:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You damned $$いがみ合う双子$$! You're a moth flying straight into the flame!」

366:t_101:1.en:
$n
「Cut the bullshit and come at me already!」

366:t_101:2.en:
$n
(I'm worried about Miss $$スズネ$$... I'll finish this quickly!)

366:t_102:0.en:
$$桂$$
「We're teaming up for the first time in ages! I need you to keep up, $$オルソン$$!」

366:t_102:1.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I know all your habits. A little time apart won't pose a problem.」

366:t_102:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Then I'll go all out! I'm so angry today my head feels like it's about to boil!」

366:t_103:0.en:
$n
(Miss $$スズネ$$... If I'd only paid more attention to you...)
